blocks.text: This Fleet Management Agreement ("Agreement") is made as of {{agreement_date}} between:
The fleet covered by this Agreement consists of the following vehicles:
The Fleet Owner may add or remove vehicles from the fleet by written notice to the Fleet Manager. Changes take effect on {{fleet_change_effective_date}}.

items: Maintain a fleet management system to track vehicle locations, assignments, mileage, fuel usage, and status.
Schedule and coordinate vehicle maintenance, repairs, and inspections.
Manage vehicle acquisition, disposal, and trade-in decisions in consultation with Fleet Owner.
Maintain records of all vehicle-related expenses, fuel purchases, tolls, and parking.
Manage driver qualifications, training, and recordkeeping (license verification, MVR checks, etc.).
Ensure compliance with all applicable regulations (USDOT, FMCSA, state transportation, environmental).
Manage fuel cards, toll accounts, and parking arrangements.
Handle insurance claims and coordinate with insurance carriers.
Provide monthly fleet reports to Fleet Owner including: mileage, fuel usage, maintenance costs, repairs, incidents, and compliance status.
{{fleet_manager_extra}}
Provide the vehicles to Fleet Manager for management pursuant to this Agreement.
Maintain ownership of all vehicles in the fleet.
Approve major maintenance, repair, and replacement decisions as specified in this Agreement.
Maintain fleet insurance (or ensure Fleet Manager maintains it, per this Agreement).
{{fleet_owner_extra}}

rows: {{operation_model}} (Fleet Owner's employees / Fleet Manager's drivers / Lease to third parties / Rental to external customers / Other)
{{use_restrictions}} (no personal use, no illegal activities, etc.)
{{maintenance_schedule}} (oil change every {{oil_change_interval}} miles, tire rotation every {{tire_rotation_interval}} miles, etc.)
{{maintenance_provider}} (Fleet Manager's in-house shop / Contracted service provider / Owner's designated shop)
{{repair_approval_threshold}} — Fleet Manager may approve repairs up to this amount without Owner's prior approval.
{{fuel_card_assignment}} (one card per driver / one card per vehicle / other)
{{fuel_restrictions}} (no cash advances, no non-fuel purchases, etc.)
Fleet Manager will track and report fuel efficiency (MPG) by vehicle monthly.

items: Fleet Manager will ensure all drivers have valid licenses and meet qualifications.
Fleet Manager will conduct motor vehicle record (MVR) checks on all drivers: {{mvr_frequency}}.
Fleet Manager will maintain a driver safety program including: {{safety_program}}.
Fleet Manager will ensure vehicles pass all required inspections.
Fleet Manager will maintain DOT required records (if applicable): driver logs, HOS records, vehicle inspection reports, etc.
Fleet Manager will report any accidents, incidents, or violations to Fleet Owner within {{incident_reporting_hours}} hours.
{{safety_extra}}

rows: {{insurance_type}} (Commercial auto liability / Physical damage / Cargo / Umbrella / Other)
Fleet Manager will provide annual loss runs to Fleet Owner upon request.
{{fleet_mgmt_fee}} (flat monthly fee / percentage of fleet costs / per-vehicle fee / other)
{{reimbursable_expenses}} (minor repairs, fuel, tolls, parking, etc., as pre-approved).
Fleet Manager will provide monthly expense reports with receipts.

blocks.text: When a vehicle is retired from the fleet:

items: Fleet Manager will prepare the vehicle for sale or auction (cleaning, minor repairs if needed).
Fleet Owner will approve the disposal method and minimum sale price.
Proceeds from sale (less any lien payoff and sale expenses) will be remitted to Fleet Owner.
Fleet Manager's commission on sale: {{sale_commission}}% of sale price (if applicable).

blocks.text: This Agreement commences on {{start_date}} and continues for {{term_length}} (or until terminated). Either Party may terminate with {{termination_notice}} days written notice. Fleet Owner may terminate immediately for cause.
Upon termination, Fleet Manager will return all vehicles, records, and equipment to Fleet Owner in good condition.
This Agreement is governed by the laws of {{governing_state}}.
